name: Wes Empire Gallery Studio
author: wesempire

sections.description:
Wes Empire Gallery Studio is a high-performance, modular WordPress gallery engine built to showcase photography, portfolio collections, and multimedia albums.

It features multiple dynamic visual layouts including standard grid, dynamic masonry, justified rows, mosaic, single column list, and responsive touch-enabled slider carousels.

Key Features

  • Multiple Layout Styles: Grid, Masonry, Justified Rows, Mosaic, List, and Carousel.
  • Modern Lightbox: Touch/swipe-enabled lightbox modal with title and caption overlays.
  • High-Res Rendering: Automatic srcset optimization for fast page loads.
  • Hover Animations: Zoom, slide overlay, gold glow, 3D lift, and grayscale options.
  • Global Color Styling: Configure primary brand colors and navigation styling.

sections.installation:
1. Upload wes-empire-gallery-studio to /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via SVN.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Manage galleries under Wes Empire Gallery in your admin menu.
  4. Place shortcode [wesemgas_gallery id="..."] on any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I display a gallery?

Use the shortcode [wesemgas_gallery id="YOUR_GALLERY_ID"] generated in the editor workspace.

How do I display all galleries?

Use the master shortcode [wesemgas_all_galleries].
